doors.label: le boudoir

doors.label: l'atelier
doors.hint: Climb the staircase to the deep-blue door of the upstairs studio

zooms.label: la vitrine
zooms.hint: Look closer at the little glass display cabinet

couture.alt: The couture house salon during an afternoon fashion show, seen from the staircase, painted in ink and gouache: golden sun pours through tall arched windows onto a red catwalk; glass doors on the far left open onto the market square, where an old pigeon bows and coos to the arriving guests; a kitten climbs into a striped hatbox; a page boy pulls back a gold curtain to reveal a lady model in a blue gown while a sly man with a curly mustache peeks out from behind a velvet curtain; three little girls sing on a sofa; a flamingo struts down the catwalk on one leg; a lady holds up a different shoe in each hand, choosing; a mannequin wears a duchess's gown, a tiara bursts with sparkle on a velvet cushion and a poodle eats grapes on a purple pouffe; in front, a little girl presses her nose to a gilded glass cabinet of figurines while a shop assistant lifts out a straw hat; a rose-pink door in the back wall and a deep-blue door at the top of the stairs lead on.

vitrine.name: La vitrine · Shop Window
vitrine.alt: Close-up of the gilded glass cabinet in the sunny salon, painted in ink and gouache: a little girl presses her nose and palms to the glass; inside, a white cat sits proudly on the plumpest golden cushion, a peacock fans its tail, four owls perch on a branch and one winks, a little girl figurine turns the key of her music box with her eyes closed, and a puppy on a round mirror-pool stand holds a string of pearls; on the right a shop assistant's gloved hand lifts out a straw hat trimmed with parrot feathers and a hibiscus.

boudoir.name: Le boudoir · Boudoir

doors.label: le salon de couture
doors.hint: Go back through the rose-pink door to the fashion salon

zooms.label: le petit théâtre
zooms.hint: Look closer at the little toy theater

boudoir.alt: The backstage dressing room of the couture house on a violet evening, lit by rows of bulbs around the vanity mirrors, painted in ink and gouache: at the first mirror Maggie the stylist waves her comb and a client's hairdo grows into a sparkling tower; a gentleman in a tailcoat bows and offers a red rose; an empty white silk gown floats over the clothes rail like a friendly ghost; a kneeling lady in a green gown sprinkles sparkles over her dress; a white heron stands on one leg on a red carpet; at a little tea table a model leans in with a bow over her china teapot; a lady in a tailored cream suit and pillbox hat taps her rosy cheek as she walks; a glittering thank-you card with a red heart stands on a bench; a tailor sits on the floor by his sewing basket holding up a charm bracelet; a shy little boy blushes under his new purple hat; Luke poses in dark sunglasses and a pink scarf; a carved toy theater with its doors open sits on the floor in front; a rose-pink door on the right leads back to the salon.

theatre.name: Le petit théâtre · Little Theater
theatre.alt: Close-up of the carved toy theater on the boudoir floor: before a painted backdrop of a wide grassy plain with one lone tree, a toy horse trots onto the stage, two white geese gaze up admiringly, a giraffe stands by a stand of hats, a tailor pins a blue gown on a dress form, and a sailor waves guests aboard his little boat.

atelier.name: L'atelier · Attic Studio

doors.label: le salon de couture
doors.hint: Go back through the deep-blue door and down the stairs to the fashion salon

zooms.label: la malle
zooms.hint: Look closer inside the big open travel trunk

atelier.alt: The upstairs studio under the roof: a deep-blue door at the top right leads back down to the salon; a parrot speaks to a student, a seamstress pinning a blue jacket on a tailor's dummy winces as a giant red-headed pin pricks her finger, a duchess tries on jewels at her mirror, a troll stands by a ladder that leans away, a dancer whirls in feathers, a boy trips over a rough rock, a painter pushes a slider and the colors fade to gray, a tray of shimmering hats, a clover pendant, a poodle snubbing a mongrel, and a big open travel trunk with tiny figurines on its folded fabrics.

malle.name: La malle · Trunk
malle.alt: Close-up of the big open travel trunk in the studio: on its rim a little man figurine leaps to catch a gold coin tumbling down; on the folded fabrics inside stand deckchairs and a striped parasol beside a tiny fountain, an ice-cream cart handing a spoonful to a child, and a grandpa laughing as he sits on his big open photo album.
